Happy to help with the end card. I need a few details first, and there's one limitation you should know about.

**The limitation:** none of my tools can join clips or add new seconds to the end of an existing video. That leaves two ways to do this:
1. **Overlay on the last few seconds.** I edit the end of radio-lines.mp4 so the end card appears over the final frames. Your clip keeps its current length. This uses the free LTX 2.5 editor at 480p, and AI editing can change the look of the footage a little.
2. **Separate end-card clip.** I make a short card (an image, or a few seconds of animated video at 480p). You add it to the end of your clip in any video editor.

**What I need from you:**
- Which option you want (1 or 2)
- The exact text on the card, e.g. a title, tagline, website or call to action
- A logo, if you want one (please attach it)
- Any style or colours, e.g. "black background, white text" or "match the clip's look"
- How long it should last (about 3 seconds is typical)
